Why You'll Love Working With US ↓

Work Life-Balance

Work wherever you're comfortable with flexible hours. Whether you're at the beach or at home, you can work freely!

Friendly Atmosphere

Work in a welcoming environment alongside teammates from different time zones and build lasting connections. Unwind with the team every Thursday during Happy Hour! ;)

Grow Professionally

Learn and grow alongside our dedicated leaders. You'll also receive support with courses for personal and professional development.

Sponsored Equipment

We'll cover 50%-100% of your new laptop, monitor, desk, chair, internet plan, & any essential software.

Paid Days Off

Get 24 paid days off annually. Unused days? They can be converted to cash!

Salary Increment & Bonuses

Annual salary increases and 2-5 bonuses each year, based on your performance and initiatives.

Recruiting Process

How Our Recruiting Process Works ↓

Step 1:

Application & Screening

We review your application and get to know you better.

Step 2:

HR manager interview

Chat with our HR team to discuss your background and fit for the role.

Step 3:

Founders interview

Meet the founders and share your vision and passion.

Step 4:

Offer

Receive your offer to join our growing team!

Step 5:

Practical task or simulation

Show us your skills through a real-world task or simulation.

Step 6:

🎉 Join the team!

Welcome aboard! We're excited to have you with us.
